title: chore(deps): move @objectstack/* to the next prerelease ^18.0.0-next.0 and follow its contract (objectui#12030)
body:
Fixes #12030
Clause-②: yes — 22 published `@object-ui/*` packages declare a consumer-facing `@objectstack/*` range that moves from `^17.x` to `^18.0.0-next.0` (21 in `dependencies`, 1 in `peerDependencies`, counted from the manifests at the head), so a release would carry a published-contract change. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` at `0cc4e8fcc`: "102 source file(s) and 1 published-contract change(s) of 18 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 3 changeset(s)". `.changeset/12030-objectstack-next-18.md` declares the 22 packages `minor`, with the breaking-for-consumers note in its body; the changeset coverage of the other touched packages is below.

follow-up: objectstack-ai/objectui#12334

**Scope: the `@objectstack/*` move to `^18.0.0-next.0` and the fixes it forces. No objectui release.** Releasing objectui 18.x (the AGENTS.md §版本号策略 sync `major`, Changesets pre mode on `next`, and the two gate edits ruled in records 6148150305 and 6149296149) moves to the follow-up card above, per the scope split recorded as 6149376719. This branch carried the sync `major` and `.changeset/pre.json` for a while (`0b942ba`); they are reverted (`7ec3c2b`), and neither gate script is edited.

**Known effect after merge, intended:** `Spec Range Floors` (`scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`) cannot read `^18.0.0-next.0`: at the head it exits 1 with "The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec in a consumer-facing field". Its nightly alarm on `main` turns red, and `pnpm changeset:publish` cancels any publish until the follow-up lands. That is the fail-safe that stops a 17.x release declaring 18 ranges. The open version PR #11600 (`changeset-release/main`) refreshes toward 17.8.0 and must not be merged before the follow-up.

## What this does

- Every `@objectstack/*` range in `dependencies`, `devDependencies` and `peerDependencies` moves to `^18.0.0-next.0`: 40 ranges in 32 manifests (26 / 13 / 1). Raised textually; `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated by `pnpm install` only, never hand-edited. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0 and a second plain `pnpm install` leaves the lockfile byte-identical (measured at `e8e9a35`; lockfile and manifests unchanged since).
- npm dist-tags read today for the four `@objectstack/*` packages objectui names (`spec`, `client`, `formula`, `lint`): `next: 18.0.0-next.0`, `latest: 17.7.0`; every `18.0.0-next.0` tag peels to objectstack `d889448b93`. `next` had not moved when the final head was pushed, so objectstack-ai/objectstack#23160 (`1912af47ba`, compare reads `behind`: not an ancestor) is not in this release and #12325's reader removal stays out of scope.
- Every break the bump caused that is a mechanical follow-through of a v18 contract change is fixed here. Where a break needed a behaviour or design choice, the PR keeps today's behaviour and says so in the test; the seat judged or routed each one (record 6148150305).

## Changeset coverage

Every published package this change touches, measured on the net diff from `72594f29e` (the merge base since the `main` merge; the earlier rounds measured from `cea429b98`, before it, and the set is the same 32 published packages):

- `.changeset/12030-objectstack-next-18.md`: the 22 packages whose consumer-facing ranges move, `minor`.
- `.changeset/12030-i18n-capability-labels.md`: `@object-ui/i18n`, `minor`. The ten locale packs drop `capability.label.manage_org_presentation` and add `capability.label.manage_mailboxes` with spec 18's capability set. A key a consumer could read is removed, so the bump is `minor`, not `patch`.
- `.changeset/12030-console-bundles-spec-18.md`: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/runner`, `minor`. In both, the `@objectstack/*` ranges are `devDependencies`, but each is an app build whose published `dist` bundles them. The console bundles them in its `vendor-objectstack` chunk, measured under #11762 below. The runner is a Vite app build (`vite build`, no `build.lib`, no `external`) whose aliases compile `@object-ui/components`, `core`, `types` and other `@object-ui/*` packages from `src`; those import `@objectstack/spec` at runtime. The runner line was added in the second patch round, after the opus re-review 6158463307 measured it.
- `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` and `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` changed only a comment, and get no line. Measured: both rebuilt from source at `2c15e40cf` (`pnpm --filter … run build`, after removing `dist`); `grep -rF` over each `dist` (their `files[]` publish `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE`) finds neither the changed sentence nor the unchanged comment sentence beside it, while code strings such as `startDateField` and `ObjectKanbanRenderer` are found.
- `@object-ui/collaboration`, `mobile`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-report` and `sdui-parser` get no line. The test: does the package's published `files[]` bundle anything this change touched? In each, the only manifest change is `devDependencies["@objectstack/spec"]`, and the package's own sources are unchanged. `collaboration`, `mobile` and `sdui-parser` build with `tsc`, so their `dist` holds their own sources only. `plugin-charts` and `plugin-report` are Vite lib builds whose `rollupOptions.external` externalises every bare import, so no other package is compiled into them. None of them imports `@objectstack/spec` from non-test source.

## Pending changesets on `main` reworded (patch round 3)

Commit `0cc4e8fcc`. Eight pending `.changeset/*.md` that this change did not add carried sentences the spec-18 move makes false at release time. Each false clause is corrected in place, mostly by one clause pointing at objectui#12030; history is kept. In the quotes below, a type argument is spelled in words (`PublicBlockNodeOf` for `'element:repeater'`), because GitHub's body sanitizer eats angle-bracket fragments; the files spell it as code. The wording is all that changed: every file's frontmatter (packages and levels) is byte-identical to `0d457fe1f` (sha1 of each frontmatter block compared), and `check-changeset-overwrite` reports "declared at base" equal to "declares now" for all eight.

- `.changeset/6152-grid-default-filters-gantt-map-filter.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor; `core`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-view` patch)
  - before: "`@objectstack/spec` has typed `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid'].defaultFilters` as the same `ViewFilterRule` array as `filter`, `[{ field, operator, value }, ...]`, since 17.6.0: the legacy fallback `ObjectGrid` reads only when `filter` is absent, …"
  - after: "`@objectstack/spec` typed `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid'].defaultFilters` as the same `ViewFilterRule` array as `filter`, `[{ field, operator, value }, ...]`, from 17.6.0 until 18 retired it (see objectui#12030): the legacy fallback `ObjectGrid` read only when `filter` was absent, …"
  - before: "… so `table: { defaultFilters: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'open' }] }` now parses there, on the tolerant and the strict face and through `safeValidateSchema`."
  - after: "… so `table: { defaultFilters: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'open' }] }` parsed there through 17.x, on the tolerant and the strict face and through `safeValidateSchema`; retired in 18, see objectui#12030: the row's tombstone refuses `defaultFilters` by name, so every value, the rule array included, is refused there now."
  - before: "… with the protocol's own message, which computes the rule array from the record's keys. Respell `defaultFilters: { status: 'open' }` as `defaultFilters: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'open' }]`, or, better, move it to `filter`, which takes the same array and wins when both are written."
  - after: "… with the protocol's own message, which computed the rule array from the record's keys through 17.x (since 18, see objectui#12030, it is the retired-key message, which names `filter`). Respell `defaultFilters: { status: 'open' }` as `filter: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'open' }]`; the rule-array `defaultFilters` spelling this entry first offered is retired in 18 too."
  - before: "`ObjectGrid` lowers `defaultFilters` through the same `toFilterNode` sink as `filter`, so a rule array there sends the same `$filter` and draws the same rows as the same array written as `filter`; the sink still lowers a record or an AST that reaches the slot at runtime, …"
  - after: "`ObjectGrid` lowered `defaultFilters` through the same `toFilterNode` sink as `filter`, so a rule array there sent the same `$filter` and drew the same rows as the same array written as `filter` (retired in 18, see objectui#12030: `ObjectGrid` and `ObjectView` no longer read `defaultFilters`, so a view that still carries it renders unfiltered); the sink still lowers a record or an AST that reaches `filter` at runtime, …"
  - before: "… and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` a pin of the above through the real renderer."
  - after: "… and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` a pin of the above through the real renderer (since 18 it pins that `defaultFilters` is not read)."
- `.changeset/11880-grid-filter-handoff.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-view` patch)
  - before: "… else `table.filter` unless it lowers to nothing (absent, `[]` or `{}`), else the deprecated `table.defaultFilters`."
  - after: "… else `table.filter` unless it lowers to nothing (absent, `[]` or `{}`), else the deprecated `table.defaultFilters` (a rung retired in 18, see objectui#12030: `ObjectView` no longer reads it)."
  - before: "What did not change: which filter applies (each rung and each pair sends the same query and draws the same rows), and …"
  - after: "What did not change: which filter applies (each rung and each pair sends the same query and draws the same rows; in 18 the `table.defaultFilters` rung is retired, see objectui#12030), and …"
  - Left as written: the export and page-1 bullets, which say in the past tense what a `table.defaultFilters` did before this entry's change.
- `.changeset/12056-repeater-object-waiver.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor)
  - before: "The zod arm `ElementRepeaterBlockSchema` now applies the same `object` waiver as the spec's props gate (objectui#12056)."
  - after: "The zod arm `ElementRepeaterBlockSchema` now applies the same `object` waiver as the spec's props gate (objectui#12056); superseded in 18, see objectui#12030: spec 18 retires the flat `object`, so the arm is the row by reference, a node may omit `properties.object` whether or not it binds one, and a `properties.object` is refused by name."
  - before: "`ComponentPropsMap['element:repeater']` requires `object`." … "a node refinement puts the requirement back wherever no binding names the object."
  - after: "`ComponentPropsMap['element:repeater']` required `object` through 17.x." … "a node refinement puts the requirement back wherever no binding names the object. Both waivers and both refinements are gone in 18 (objectui#12030): the row has no flat `object` left to waive."
  - before: "**Still refused at `properties.object`.** A bag with no `object` is refused when the node has no binding that names one: … The refusal is a `custom` issue with `params.code` `ELEMENT_REPEATER_OBJECT_REQUIRED`, and its message names both remedies. A `properties.object` of the wrong type is still refused by the row itself."
  - after: "**Still refused at `properties.object` through 17.x.** A bag with no `object` was refused when the node had no binding that names one: … The refusal was a `custom` issue with `params.code` `ELEMENT_REPEATER_OBJECT_REQUIRED`, and its message named both remedies; retired in 18, see objectui#12030: the refinement and its code are deleted, so such a bag is accepted. A `properties.object` of the wrong type is still refused by the row itself, and since 18 so is any `properties.object`, by name."
  - before: "**TypeScript.** The inferred `ElementRepeaterBlockSchema` type now types `properties.object` as optional, and so does the authoring type `PublicBlockNodeOf` for `'element:repeater'` derived from it."
  - after: "**TypeScript.** The inferred `ElementRepeaterBlockSchema` type typed `properties.object` as optional through 17.x, and so did the authoring type `PublicBlockNodeOf` for `'element:repeater'` derived from it; since 18 (objectui#12030) both follow the row, which retires `object`, so a typed `properties.object: string` no longer type-checks."
- `.changeset/7611-approver-registry-read.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch)
  - before: "A `data` binding (`user`, `team`, `department`, and `position` under the installed spec 17.7.0) still renders the record lookup … The type that admits the registry member before the installed spec declares it is marked for removal when objectui moves to spec 18."
  - after: "A `data` binding (`user`, `team`, `department`, and `position` under spec 17.7.0; spec 18, which objectui installs from objectui#12030, binds `position` to the registry) still renders the record lookup … The type that admitted the registry member before the installed spec declared it was marked for removal when objectui moves to spec 18; removed in 18, see objectui#12030."
- `.changeset/11880-element-datasource-only.md` (`@object-ui/components`, `app-shell`, `i18n` patch)
  - before: "The flat keys stay published until `@objectstack/spec` retires them in v18; each input's description now says it is not read and names the binding member that is."
  - after: "The flat keys stayed published, each input's description saying it is not read and naming the binding member that is, until `@objectstack/spec` retired them in 18: the record picker's four inputs left with that retirement (objectui#12030), and `element:number`'s two with objectui#12085."
- `.changeset/12056-repeater-datasource.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch)
  - before: "… and `objectui validate` accepts the node the designer now writes, because `@object-ui/types` takes the spec gate's `object` waiver for this element in the same change."
  - after: "… and `objectui validate` accepts the node the designer now writes: `@object-ui/types` took the spec gate's `object` waiver for this element in the same change, and since 18 (objectui#12030) the row has no flat `object` left to require."
- `.changeset/11880-repeater-datasource.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor, `@object-ui/components` patch), found by the grep beyond the six named
  - before: "Its flat `properties.object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit` stay read, as the fallback, until `@objectstack/spec` retires them in v18, so a repeater that carries only the flat keys reads exactly as before."
  - after: "Its flat `properties.object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit` stay read, as the fallback (spec 18 retires them as authored keys, see objectui#12030, and the renderer keeps this read for metadata written before), so a repeater that carries only the flat keys reads exactly as before."
  - before: "… by reference, and its bag's `object` stays required. Clause-②: the strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`) now ACCEPTS a repeater carrying `properties.object` plus a well-formed `dataSource`, which it refused as an unrecognized key; …"
  - after: "… by reference, and its bag's `object` stays required (until objectui#12056's waiver, and retired in 18, see objectui#12030). Clause-②: the strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`) now ACCEPTS a repeater carrying `properties.object` plus a well-formed `dataSource`, which it refused as an unrecognized key (since 18 it refuses `properties.object` by name, so the accepted node carries the binding alone); …"
  - before: "A repeater whose bag omits `object` is refused at `properties.object` on both faces, as before."
  - after: "A repeater whose bag omits `object` is refused at `properties.object` on both faces, as before; retired in 18, see objectui#12030: such a repeater is accepted."
  - One clause here went false with objectui#12085, not with this change, and is corrected in the same edit because it sits in the same bullet: before "The registration now publishes the injected `dataSource` input; `object` stays required." after "The registration now publishes the injected `dataSource` input; `object` stays required (until objectui#12085 dropped the flat query inputs)." Evidence: the `element:repeater` registration in `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx` at the head publishes `titleField`, `fields`, `emptyText`, `divided` and no `object`, and `.changeset/12085-element-binding-inputs.md` states the drop. The seat may ask for this one clause back out.
- `.changeset/12093-spec-main-compile.md` (empty frontmatter, no release)
  - before: "… a retired-key tombstone on objectstack `main`), and `@object-ui/app-shell`'s zh-CN overlay-scope label table keys `org` beside the spec's union (objectstack `main` narrows that union to `env`)."
  - after: "… a retired-key tombstone on objectstack `main`; the read itself is retired in 18, see objectui#12030), and `@object-ui/app-shell`'s zh-CN overlay-scope label table keys `org` beside the spec's union (objectstack `main` narrows that union to `env`; the `org` label is dropped in 18, see objectui#12030)."

The grep over all 438 pending `.changeset/*.md`, besides this change's own three: `defaultFilters` hits 6152, 11880-grid-filter-handoff and 12093; `ELEMENT_REPEATER_OBJECT_REQUIRED` hits 12056-repeater-object-waiver only; `ELEMENT_NUMBER_OBJECT_REQUIRED` and `manage_org_presentation` hit nothing; the overlay-scope `org` hits 12093 only (12171-environment-overlay-copy names the environment overlay and stays true); the flat element query keys and the record picker hit 11880-element-datasource-only, 11880-repeater-datasource, 12056-repeater-datasource, 12056-repeater-object-waiver and 12085-element-binding-inputs. Read and left as written, each still true at release: `12085-element-binding-inputs.md` (the repeater renderer still reads its flat keys as the fallback; this change does not touch it), `11903-record-picker-layout.md` (the `RecordPickerDialog`, not `element:record_picker`), `12086-edit-inline-default-on.md`, `7611-capability-registry.md` (names no curated capability), `7611-decision-output-position-registry.md`, and the "since 17.7.0" mentions elsewhere, which date a fact and do not say what is installed.

## Merge of `main`

`main` at `72594f29e` is merged into this branch (merge commit `1c95e13af`): six commits, merged cleanly, none touching a manifest or the lockfile. Files both sides changed: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` and the ten `packages/i18n` locale packs. The re-run after the merge is under Gates.

## The break list (measured first, at `a3f41ed`: the bump and changeset alone)

Full vitest suite in five lock-held groups: 50 files, 159 tests red (types/core 15 files / 58 tests, app-shell 21 / 45, plugins A 6 / 20, plugins B 1 / 4, console + scripts 7 / 32). `turbo run build` and every package's `type-check` were green at that commit (81/81). Two repo gates were red: `check:eager-closure` (exit 2, ceilings drifted to 1.74x / 1.21x) and `check:installed-pin-claims` (23 findings). By area, and how each is closed:

- **Overlay scope is `env` only** (objectstack#15206 S5; card comment 6098299437): data-objectstack overlay fixtures and docblock, two app-shell fixtures, and the zh scope label table drops its `org` row (an `org` from an older server renders raw), as the ruling's seat judgment says.
- **Index `unique: true` refused at protocol 18** (objectstack#22103): the index-fallback probe pins the refusal with a `false` control, the validation-preview help (en, zh) names `unique: 'organization'` / `unique: 'global'`, and the `data-protocol.ts` docblock says refused. These are the three sites #11864 names; its legacy-row rendering case still passes and is left as is.
- **Capabilities**: `manage_mailboxes` in, `manage_org_presentation` out; curated label set, default label, ten locale packs.
- **Page blocks**: the element:number / element:repeater / element:record_picker flat query keys and object-grid `defaultFilters` are tombstones refusing by name (objectstack#11509). The number and repeater arms take the spec row by reference; the record_picker node and registration stop publishing the four keys; the parity, arm, harvest and ratchet pins read the tombstones.
- **Retired reads removed** (seat judgment under the ruling): `ObjectGrid` no longer reads `defaultFilters` and `ObjectView` no longer reads `table.defaultFilters`; no in-repo producer writes the key. The tests that pinned it as a working alias are flipped to pin it inert beside a canonical `filter` control; the plugin-view README and docs page, the registration's `filter` description and the type's JSDoc say retired. The element:repeater renderer's flat `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit` fallback reads stay: `apps/console/src/dev/DevLists.tsx` writes `properties.object` and `properties.limit` and is routed in `App.tsx`, a live in-repo producer, reported instead of deleted. element:number and element:record_picker already read the binding only.
- **New spec checks and keys**: `checkPageSlotPair` attached to both page node schemas beside the existing page checks (and listed among the chained refinements in the import-boundary census); `checkPagePrintComposition` and `checkListViewChartBinding` read a discriminator and are listed as not attachable; ObjectSchema's 45th key `attachedOnRead`; record:details sections' experimental `count` listed as deferred; the three new record component types stay out of the block palette, as today.
- **ListView `requiredPermissions`**: pinned as the one pending declaration; the seat files a declare-and-enforce card.
- **Flow dialect** (ADR-0032 §3): flow fixtures move to the spellings v18 accepts. The value-role ledger now names six key/value maps; each node's own config schema was measured to refuse a malformed envelope with exactly the sentences the editor shows. A `{token}` string in a value slot is refused by the spec and the editor shows that refusal; the recipient picker's `{…}` spellings and a blank Notify title are pinned as PENDING. The Studio cutover rides #11824.
- **Approver `position`** is a registry binding in v18: the spec-17 loosening is removed and the identity, directory and lookup pins read the registry arm.
- **Submit-redirect / url action**: the refusal pins read the spec's own message; a url action target fixture is a path.
- **Installed-spec claims**: re-measured and restamped where the fact holds, one historical mention ledgered; `e2e/live/ci/backend.env` moves to `18.0.0-next.0`; `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` re-synced by its script; lockfile-integrity samples re-keyed; the declared-floor reader in core's test reads a prerelease floor by its core triple.

## #11762: the eager-closure line comes down by the payback

objectstack#22044 (`93125aeeb8`) is an ancestor of the `18.0.0-next.0` tag commit (compare `ahead`, behind 0; control: the 17.7.0 tag commit `4e4e881427` also reads `ahead`). Two console builds, one container, one instrument (`CI=true pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --concurrency=2` under the verify lock, reading `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`):

| chunk | `cea429b` (main, 17.7.0) | `5488ae7` (this branch) | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `vendor-objectstack` | 1,599,281 | 1,512,690 | -86,591 |
| `ui-components` | 285,771 | 284,925 | -846 |
| everything else (70 names) | 1,324,632 | 1,324,848 | +216 |
| aggregate | 3,209,684 | 3,122,463 | -87,221 |

`MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` 3,281,467 to 3,194,246 and `BASELINE` onto `5488ae7`; `vendor-objectstack` ceiling 1,623,000 to 1,536,409 and its baseline onto the same build. Lowered by the amount, not re-derived and not rounded; `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES` untouched. Headroom 71,783 bytes = 0.79x on the aggregate, 23,719 = 0.26x on `vendor-objectstack`: what `main` had on `cea429b`. The ruling's two later edits reach bundler inputs; the console build of `5db13ba` reads 3,122,375 (-88), inside the band, recorded in the `BASELINE` prose and not re-pinned. The upstream figure (-226,301 on the chunk) was on an injected dist; the real release nets -86,591 here.

## Gates (final head `0cc4e8fcc`; each reading names the commit it ran on)

**Patch round 3** (`0cc4e8fcc`: pending-changeset wording only, eight `.changeset/*.md`, no code, manifest or lockfile):

- At `0cc4e8fcc`, one script under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (the script exits 1 if any gate does), each gate exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` ("102 source file(s) and 1 published-contract change(s) of 18 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 3 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major` ("No changeset declares a `major` bump."), `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only: "3 changeset(s) added, 8 modified, 0 deleted", and for each of the eight the declared packages and levels at base equal those now), `check:changeset-claims` ("No pending changeset names a file this change touches."), `check:pending-changeset-literals` ("No test source names a pending changeset."), `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes` ("OK (scanned 8636 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)"), `check:installed-pin-claims` (`OK`).
